en.title: Trickier percentages
en.teach: Percent means out of 100. 10% of {n} is {tenth}, so {p}% of {n} is {tenth} × {p} ÷ 10 = {answer}.

de.title: Knifflige Prozente
de.teach: Prozent heißt von hundert. 10 % von {n} sind {tenth}, also sind {p} % von {n} {tenth} × {p} ÷ 10 = {answer}.

fr.title: Pourcentages astucieux
fr.teach: Pour cent veut dire sur 100. 10 % de {n}, c’est {tenth}, donc {p} % de {n}, c’est {tenth} × {p} ÷ 10 = {answer}.

yo.title: Ìdá-ọgọ́rùn-ún tó le díẹ̀
yo.teach: Ìdá-ọgọ́rùn-ún túmọ̀ sí nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún. 10% nínú {n} jẹ́ {tenth}, nítorí náà {p}% nínú {n} jẹ́ {tenth} × {p} ÷ 10 = {answer}.
